name: United Kingdom
study_positioning: Strong destination for undergraduate, postgraduate, foundation, and English-language routes.
recommended_tests: IELTS Academic or UKVI where required

additional_costs: Immigration Health Surcharge depends on visa length
Priority services are optional where available
process: Receive CAS from licensed student sponsor
Prepare funds, academic documents, passport and English evidence
Pay visa fee and healthcare surcharge
visa.deadlines: Apply before course start date and after CAS issue. Arrival is allowed up to 1 month before courses longer than 6 months, or up to 1 week before courses of 6 months or less.
notes: Do not travel before the visa start date.
